Good evening, reception. How can I help you?
Good evening. This is room 304. There are no towels in the bathroom.
I am very sorry. How many towels do you need?
Four, please. I am here with my family.
Certainly. Would you also like me to send up some extra pillows for the little ones?
Sorry, I don't understand. Can you speak more slowly, please?
Of course. Pillows — for the children. Do you want more?
Yes, please. Two pillows. And is there a hair dryer in the room?
No, there is not. But there is one at the reception, and it is free.
Thank you. One more thing: the elevator on my floor is not working.
Thank you for telling me. I send someone now. Use the stairs, or the second elevator.
Perfect. And what time is breakfast?
From seven to ten, on the ground floor. Your key opens the door. Good night.

Good evening, and welcome to the Park Hotel. This is a short message about your room. There is one big bed and there are two small beds, so there is space for four people. In the bathroom there is a shower, and there are four towels. There is no hair dryer in the room, but there is one at the reception and it is free. Breakfast is from seven to ten in the morning, on the ground floor. Check-out is at eleven. If you need anything at all, dial nine and talk to the reception. We speak English very slowly for our visitors, and we are happy to repeat. Have a very good night.

Good morning. This is a message for the guests who leave today. Check-out is at eleven, but if you need more time, please call the reception and we give you one extra hour, with no cost. You can leave your bags with us after check-out, and take them in the afternoon. There is a small room for bags next to the reception. Please remember to leave the key at the desk, or in the box by the door. If you take something from the mini bar this morning, tell us, because it is not on the bill yet. And if you need a taxi to the airport, call us thirty minutes before. Thank you for staying with us.
Good evening. This is room 304. There are no towels in the bathroom. Can you send someone, please? And what time is breakfast? Thank you very much.
